sampling_model.design: The store-or-match action and partner choice use only observed covariates and the auxiliary matching seed, never treatment assignments or orientation signs. Operationally, a stored arrival receives an immediate private fair assignment and a later completing arrival receives the opposite treatment. Conditional on the realized units and matching seed, treatment-blind matching makes this law identical to drawing one independent fair orientation sign after each pair is completed; the potential outcomes remain fixed.
sampling_model.units: An outer iid law for \((X_i,Y_i(0),Y_i(1))\) defines the minimax expected design risk and the unknown prognostic score; it is not used to replace the finite-population causal estimand.
sampling_model.treatment: Every unit is assigned at its arrival and the assignment is never revised. Exactly one unit in each arrival-incidence pair receives treatment and the other receives control; conditional on the completed matching, the pair orientations are independent and each has probability \(1/2\).
sampling_model.overlap: The known marginal treatment probability is \(1/2\) for every unit.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: None. The policy observes covariates only and does not know or estimate \(g\); \(g\) indexes the law class and the offline precision oracle.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorem 1 identifies adjacent pairing after sorting \(g\) as MSE-optimal among half-treatment stratifications.
Theorems 1--2 give an offline-variance CLT for an uncapped packing reservoir with a negligible unmatched remainder.
Theorem 1 gives an \(O(\log^2 T)\)-competitive general-arrivals line-matching algorithm under unknown iid arrivals.
The pigeonhole theorem bounds geometric discrepancy for immediate cellwise treatment balancing without a reservoir.
Hierarchical Greedy attains dimension-dependent spatial matching rates with initial or replenished supply.
Tree embedding yields an \(O(\log n)\)-competitive algorithm for min-cost perfect matching with delays.
Covariate-close offline matched pairs admit asymptotically exact superpopulation ATE inference.
Offline matched tuples admit joint asymptotic normality and consistent covariance estimation for treatment contrasts.
Fixed-\(k\) matching with delays on \(H\)-metrics has an \(O(\log n)\) competitive ratio.

body.tldr: The target result characterizes the exact order of the precision loss caused by a hard unmatched-unit reservoir and a common enrollment deadline in online matched-pair randomization. Matching decisions use only covariate history; immediate private assignments admit an equivalent deferred representation in which every completed pair receives one independent fair orientation. Conditional on fixed potential outcomes, these orientations give an exactly design-unbiased IPW estimator, and averaging its assignment variance over the law class reduces the matching-dependent excess to \(R_T(B)\). The proposed theorem proves \(R_T(B)\asymp b^{-2\beta/d}+T^{-1}\sum_{r=1}^{b}r^{-2\beta/d}\), supplies a capped fixed-branching coarsening policy, and shows that offline first-order precision is attainable if and only if \(B_T\to\infty\). The lower bound and coarse policy have concrete proof architectures; endpoint-safe clearing in the deadline-dominated regime is the exposed open question.

project_justification.gap: Offline matched-pair theory identifies the prognostic-score oracle, and recent online reservoir work gives asymptotic sufficient conditions, but no result prices a deterministic reservoir cap jointly with forced terminal completion.
project_justification.niche: The missing object is an additive, finite-horizon capacity--deadline frontier for causal design variance, rather than a tuning heuristic, a competitive ratio, or a CLT that discards the unmatched remainder.
project_justification.fill: A weighted-suffix all-policy converse and a fixed-branching coarsening construction deliver matching orders, an implementable design certificate, and the iff memory rule.

body.related_work: \cite{bai2022optimality} supplies the offline oracle by showing that sorting the prognostic sum and pairing adjacent units minimizes conditional MSE among half-treatment stratifications. \cite{kapelnerkrieger2023learning} supplies the operational reservoir and the SeqExpMatch consumer, while leaving time- and occupancy-dependent tuning unresolved. Morrison's \emph{Reservoir Designs for Online Paired Experiments}, arXiv:2505.17247v1 (22 May 2025), defines covariate-determined reservoir matching in Section 2 and proves its packing-based asymptotic guarantees in Theorems 1--2; \cite{morrison2025reservoir} informs the variance reduction but allows a negligible unmatched remainder and is not a finite-cap or forced-empty comparator. Zhao and Zhou's \emph{Pigeonhole Design: Balancing Sequential Experiments from an Online Matching Perspective}, Management Science 71(3), 1889--1908, doi:10.1287/mnsc.2023.02184, supplies the cellwise partition and parity accounting, including the stopping-time decomposition in Theorem 6, but has no stored-unmatched occupancy or terminal clearing; see \cite{zhaozhou2024pigeonhole}. \cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals} supplies a coarsening proof for forced perfect matching under general arrivals, but its pool is uncapped and its objective is a line-metric competitive ratio. \cite{kanoria2025dynamicspatial} and \cite{azarchiplunkarkaplan2017delays} motivate multiscale charging under replenishment or delay prices, neither of which controls an adapted depleting reservoir at a fixed endpoint. \cite{bairomanoshaikh2022inference}, \cite{bailiutabordmeehan2024tuples}, and \cite{melnykwangwattenhofer2021kway} inform nonselected inference and multiarm extensions and are not theorem-level targets of the selected pairwise frontier.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The endpoint-safe clearance inequality is not established. The fixed-branching handle must control inherited cell workloads uniformly over the entire bounded-density class without treating multinomial cell counts as independent or invoking unquantified de-Poissonization. Exact finite-state diagnostics reproduced 691 weighted-suffix certificates through \(T=12\). Separate uniform-law simulations at \((d,\beta)=(1,1/2)\) and \((2,1)\) did not reject branching slack \(A=8\) through \(T=2048\), whereas \(A=4\) caused frequent early clearing in two dimensions. These computations are policy diagnostics only and do not support the theorem.
body.honest_scope: Every formal statement remains to be proved. The exact design-variance identity, adjacent scalar oracle, lower prior, weighted-suffix inequality, and coarse grid policy have explicit derivation paths that require independent checking. The full upper frontier depends on the open endpoint-safe coarsening question. No CLT, variance estimator, outcome-adaptive score learner, multiarm tuple frontier, exact leading constant, or guarantee for the response-adaptive CARA implementation is claimed. As a sanity reduction, a constant prognostic score makes every matching cost and every per-law variance excess exactly zero; the nontrivial minimax frontier arises from uniform performance over the Hölder class.
